name: 海豹船长
evolution: 海豹战士 → 海豹船长 Lv.40
description: 由聪慧且经验丰富的海豹战士进化而来，拥有极强的领地意识。这一物种对征服有极端的渴望，认为其他精灵都要臣服于它们。会指挥手下的海豹战士战斗。
descriptionEn: Evolved from wise and experienced Haibaozhanshi, it has a very strong sense of territory. This species has an extreme desire to conquer, believing all other spirits should submit to them. It commands subordinate Haibaozhanshi to fight.
